prompt: I'm a concert venue in Washington, D.C. Blink-182 played here on their tour the same year Brazil won their fifth FIFA World Cup. What was my name in 2010?
answer:
Brazil won its fifth FIFA World Cup in **2002**. Blink-182 played in Washington, D.C. at the **MCI Center** that year, which was renamed the **Verizon Center** in 2006.

So, its name in **2010** was **Verizon Center**.
